## Make data for CONSORT flowchart

## Read data 

Read file compiled in `01_prepare_data.Rmd`:
```{r}
d0 <- get_derived_data()

# Exceptions
except <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/exceptions.rds")
```

Read file compiled in `11_derive_variables.Rmd`:
```{r}
adat <- get_analysis_data()

# IDs
did <- readRDS(file = "02_data_derived/all_subject_ids.rds")
```


### Participants excluded

IDs of excluded participants
```{r}
excl_ids <- did[is.na(rand_id), unique(ID)]
```

Participants with a standard pre-coded exclusion reason
```{r}
excl_dt1 <- d0[ID %in% excl_ids & 
                 variable == "screen_noninkl_aarsag" & 
                 c_value != "Andet (uddyb)"][, .(ID, c_value)]
setnames(excl_dt1, "c_value", "excl_reason")
```

Participants with free-text exclusion reasons (manually reviewed)
```{r}
# List manually reviewed free-text exclusion reasons from exceptions file
excl_exceptions <- except[grep("^exclusion_", names(except))]

excl_dt2 <- data.table(
  excl_reason = rep(names(excl_exceptions), lengths(excl_exceptions)),
  ID = as.integer(unlist(excl_exceptions, use.names = FALSE))
)
```

Violations of inclusion/exclusion criteria registered in `inklusion_...` or  `eksklusion_...` variables
```{r}
excl_ids3 <- setdiff(excl_ids, c(excl_dt1$ID, excl_dt2$ID))
excl_dt3a <- d0[ID %in% excl_ids3 & 
                 ((substr(variable, 1,10) == "inklusion_" & c_value != "Yes") | 
                    (substr(variable, 1,11) == "eksklusion_" & c_value != "No"))]
excl_dt3a[, excl_reason := paste0(variable, ": ", c_value)]

# Choose first violated criteria per participant:
excl_dt3 <- excl_dt3a[, .SD[1], .(ID, date)][, .(ID, excl_reason)]
```

Collect data on all excluded participants:
```{r}
excl_dt <- rbind(excl_dt1, 
                 excl_dt2,
                 excl_dt3)

# Sanity checks: One row per excluded participant, none randomized
stopifnot(nrow(excl_dt) == length(excl_ids))
stopifnot(nrow(excl_dt) == excl_dt[, uniqueN(ID)])
stopifnot(nrow(d0[ID %in% excl_dt$ID & !is.na(rand_id)]) == 0)
```

Group exclusion reasons
```{r}
# Not moderate/severe depression
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Ikke moderat-til-svær depression",
                           "inklusion_madrs: No",
                           "inklusion_depression: No"),
        exclusion_reason := "Did not meet criteria for current moderate-to-severe depression"]

# Declined participation
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Har ikke lyst til/mulighed for at deltage",
                           "Deltageren har ikke kunne kontaktes per telefon eller mail",
                           "exclusion_declined_participation"),
        exclusion_reason := "Declined participation or could not be contacted"]

#Prior or current psychiatric disorders
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c(paste("Er eller har været diagnosticeret med psykotisk lidelse,",
                                 "personlighedsforstyrrelse, spiseforstyrrelse eller bipolar",
                                 "affektiv sindslidelse"),
                           "eksklusion_prevpsych: Yes",
                           "exclusion_psychiatric_disorders"),
        exclusion_reason :=  "Current or previous diagnosis with psychotic disorder, 
        personality disorder, bipolar disorder or eating disorder"]

# Not fluent in Danish
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Taler ikke dansk", 
                           "exclusion_not_fluent_in_danish"),
        exclusion_reason := "Not fluent in Danish"]

# No current pharmacological treatment
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Ingen farmakologisk behandling mod depression",
                           "inklusion_med: No",
                           "exclusion_no_pharmacological_treatment"),
        exclusion_reason := "No current pharmacological treatment for depression"]

# Concurrent medical treatments
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Behandles med kalium-depleterende diuretika",
                           "Har fået ECT-, MAO-I- eller TMS-behandling indenfor de seneste 14 dage",
                           "Er i behandling med glukokortikoider",
                           "eksklusion_diuretics: Yes",
                           "exclusion_concurrent_medical_condition"),
        exclusion_reason := "Concurrent medical treatments"]

# First degree relative with bipolar disorder
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Har 1.2- gradsslægtning med bipolar affektiv sindslidelse",
                           "eksklusion_fambipolar: Yes"),
        exclusion_reason := "First degree relative with bipolar disorder"]

# Somatic illness (diabetes, immunodeficiency, epilepsy etc.)
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Er diagnosticeret med diabetes",
                           "Er immundefekt",
                           "Har epilepsi",
                           "Har hæmatologisk malignitet",
                           "Har systemisk svampeinfektion eller aktiv TB",
                           "Har systemisk sklerose"),
        exclusion_reason := "Somatic illness (diabetes, immunodeficiency, epilepsy etc.)"]

# Active, suicidal plans
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Har selvmordsplaner",
                           "eksklusion_suicide: Yes"),
        exclusion_reason := "Active suicidal plans"]

# Age < 18 or >64
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Under 18 eller over 64 år"),
        exclusion_reason := "<18 or >64 years old"]

# Active alcohol or substance use disorder
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("exclusion_aud_or_sud"),
        exclusion_reason := "Active alcohol or substance use disorder"]

# Other reasons
excl_dt[excl_reason %in% c("Ikke tilknyttet Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri",
                           "eksklusion_alat: Yes",
                           "Er gravid eller ikke-adhærent til antikontraceptiva",
                           "Allergisk overfor glukokortikoider",
                           "exclusion_other"),
        exclusion_reason := "Other reason for exclusion"]

stopifnot(excl_dt[is.na(exclusion_reason), .N] == 0)
```

```{r}
# Initiate individual flowchart data
flow_dt <- merge(did, excl_dt[, .(ID, exclusion_reason)], all.x = TRUE)
```

### Treatment assignment and safety analysis set eligibility
```{r}
# Take first record per ID to avoid duplicates from multi-row adat
adat[, i_sas := as.integer(c_SAS == "yes")]
flow_dt <- merge(flow_dt, adat[, .(ID, trt, i_sas)][, .SD[1], ID], all.x = TRUE)
```

### Discontinuation of the intervention

Compliant participants
```{r}
## Took all doses
ids_compliant1 <- d0[variable == "compliance" & 
                        part == "janej" & 
                        c_value == "Ja", unique(ID)]
## 4 individuals deemed compliant by investigator despite not completing all doses
ids_compliant2 <- as.integer(except$deemed_compliant)
stopifnot(length(ids_compliant2) == 4)

protocol_compliance <- data.table(ID = c(ids_compliant1, ids_compliant2),
                                  discontinued_trt = 0,
                                  non_compliance_reason = NA_character_)
```

Non-compliant participants
```{r}
# 2 discontinued by clinician, due to adverse event
ids_trt_discontinuation_clinician <- as.integer(except$trt_discontinuation_clinician)
stopifnot(length(ids_trt_discontinuation_clinician) == 2)
discontinued_by_clinician <- data.table(ID = ids_trt_discontinuation_clinician,
                                        discontinued_trt = 1,
                                        non_compliance_reason = "by clinician, due to adverse event")

# 1 discontinued by participant, due to adverse event
ids_trt_discontinuation_participant <- as.integer(except$trt_discontinuation_participant)
stopifnot(length(ids_trt_discontinuation_participant) == 1)
discontinued_by_participant <- data.table(ID = ids_trt_discontinuation_participant,
                                          discontinued_trt = 1,
                                          non_compliance_reason = "by participant, due to adverse event")

# Combine and merge onto flow_dt
compl_dt <- rbind(protocol_compliance,
                  discontinued_by_clinician,
                  discontinued_by_participant)
flow_dt <- merge(flow_dt, compl_dt, all.x = TRUE)

stopifnot(adat[!(ID %in% compl_dt$ID), .N] == 0)
```

### Followed-up at day 4, 7, 14, 28 (MADRS-10)

```{r}
madrs10_dates <- adat[f_visit %in% c("day0","day4", "day7", "day14","day28") & 
                        variable == "madrs" & 
                        part == "total10" & 
                        state == "in_window" &
                        !is.na(value), 
                      .SD[1], by = c("f_visit", "ID")
                      ][, .(ID, f_visit)]

madrs10_dates[, indicator := 1]
madrs10_dates <- dcast(madrs10_dates, 
                       ID ~ f_visit, 
                       value.var = "indicator", 
                       fill = 0)
madrs10_dates <- madrs10_dates[, !"day0"]

flow_dt <- merge(flow_dt, madrs10_dates, all.x = TRUE)
```

### Contribution to the primary outcome 

Policy estimand:
```{r}
# Participants with a MADRS-10 assessment at day 4 or day 7 in-window
flow_dt[!is.na(rand_id), policy := ifelse(day4 + day7 > 0, 1,0)]
```

Efficacy estimand:
```{r}
# Participants with a MADRS-10 at day 4 or 7 in window AND recorded as 
# on-treatment at both visits
efficacy_estimand <- adat[f_visit %in% c("day4", "day7") & 
                             variable == "madrs" & 
                             part == "total10" & 
                             state == "in_window", 
                           .(efficacy = as.integer(all(c_on_treat != "no"))),
                           keyby = .(ID)]

flow_dt <- merge(flow_dt, efficacy_estimand, all.x = TRUE)
```

Save flowchart data to `.rds` file:
```{r}
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
regi <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "consort_diagram"][1L]
dt_list <- list(flow_dt) |> setNames(nm = regi[, endpoint_id])

saveRDS(dt_list, file = "50_output_db/outputs/flowchart_overview.rds")
```


## Creating flowchart with consort package

Layout functions
```{r}
# Build an indented list from a named integer vector
indent <- function(labels, counts, level = 1) {
  paste0(strrep("\t", level), counts, " ", labels, collapse = "\n")
}

# Build an unindented list from a named integer vector
inline <- function(labels, counts) {
  paste0(counts, " ", labels, collapse = "\n")
}

# Pad each line of (possibly multi-line) strings to a fixed width
pad_txt <- function(txt, width = 50, indent_wrap = 3) {
  sapply(txt, function(t) {
    lines <- strsplit(t, "\n")[[1]]

    # Indentation level
    level       <- nchar(regmatches(lines, regexpr("^\t*", lines)))
    clean_lines <- sub("^\t*", "", lines)

    padded <- sapply(seq_along(lines), function(i) {
      ind        <- strrep(" ", indent_wrap * level[i])
      wrap_width <- width - nchar(ind)

      wrapped <- strwrap(clean_lines[i], width = wrap_width)
      wrapped <- c(
        paste0(ind, wrapped[1]),
        if (length(wrapped) > 1) paste0(ind, strrep(" ", indent_wrap), wrapped[-1])
      )
      paste(formatC(wrapped, width = width, flag = "-"), collapse = "\n")
    })

    paste(padded, collapse = "\n")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

pad_box <- function(txt, h_pad = 3, v_pad = 1) {
  sapply(txt, function(t) {
    lines   <- strsplit(t, "\n")[[1]]
    h_padded <- paste0(strrep(" ", h_pad), lines, strrep(" ", h_pad))
    v_padded <- c(strrep(" ", h_pad), h_padded, strrep(" ", h_pad))
    paste(v_padded, collapse = "\n")
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

lower_first_letter <- function(x) paste0(tolower(substr(x, 1, 1)), substr(x, 2, nchar(x)))
```

Extracting numbers and making labels
```{r}
# Screened
n_screened <- flow_dt[, uniqueN(ID)]
screen_txt <- "participants were screened for eligibility"

# Excluded (side-box)
n_excluded <- flow_dt[, sum(is.na(rand_id))]
excl <- flow_dt[!is.na(exclusion_reason), .N, by = exclusion_reason][order(-N)]
excl[N < 3, exclusion_reason := "Other reason"]
excl <- excl[, .(N = sum(N)), by = exclusion_reason][order(-N)]
# Remove line shifts in labels, so pad_txt can wrap them correctly
excl[, exclusion_reason := gsub("\\s*\n\\s*", " ", exclusion_reason)]
excl_txt <- pad_txt(paste0(
  n_excluded, " were excluded:\n",
  indent(excl$exclusion_reason, excl$N, level = 1)
))

# Randomized
n_rand     <- flow_dt[, sum(!is.na(rand_id))]
rand_txt <- "undervent randomization"

# Treatment assignment
arms      <- as.character(flow_dt[!is.na(trt), unique(trt)])
arms      <- c(arms[!grepl("^[Pp]lacebo", arms)], arms[grepl("^[Pp]lacebo", arms)])
n_per_arm <- setNames(sapply(arms, function(a) flow_dt[trt == a, .N]), arms)

trt_labels <- setNames(
  c(paste0("were assigned to and recieved ", 
           lower_first_letter(arms[1]), 
           " (4mg x 4 days + 2mg x 3 days)"),
    paste0("were assigned to and recieved ", 
           lower_first_letter(arms[2]), 
           " (7 days)")),
  arms
)
arm_labels <- pad_txt(paste(n_per_arm[arms], trt_labels))

# Discontinuation of intervention
mk_disc_text <- function(a) {
  disc <- flow_dt[trt == a & !is.na(non_compliance_reason), .N, 
                  by = non_compliance_reason]
  paste0(sum(disc$N), " discontinued the intervention\n",
         indent(disc$non_compliance_reason, disc$N, level = 1))}
disc_txt <- pad_txt(sapply(arms, function(a) mk_disc_text(a)))

# Followed-up
visits   <- c("were followed up at day 4" = "day4", 
              "were followed up at day 7" = "day7", 
              "were followed up at day 14" = "day14", 
              "were followed up at day 28" = "day28")
mk_fu_text <- function(a) {
  fu_counts <- sapply(visits, function(v) flow_dt[trt == a & get(v) == 1L, .N])
  inline(names(visits), fu_counts)}
fu_txt   <- pad_txt(sapply(arms, mk_fu_text))

# Analyses
analyses <- c("contributed to the primary estimand (treatment policy)*" = "policy", 
              "contributed to the secondary estimand (treatment efficacy)*" = "efficacy", 
              "were included in the safety analysis set" = "i_sas")
mk_an_text <- function(a) {
  an_counts <- sapply(analyses, function(v) flow_dt[trt == a & get(v) == 1L, .N])
  inline(names(analyses), an_counts)
}
an_txt <- pad_txt(sapply(arms, mk_an_text))
```

Build CONSORT diagram
```{r}
g <- add_box(txt = pad_box(paste(n_screened, screen_txt))) |>
  add_side_box(txt = pad_box(excl_txt)) |>
  add_box(txt = pad_box(paste(n_rand, rand_txt))) |>
  add_split(txt = pad_box(arm_labels), just = "left") |>
  add_box(txt = pad_box(disc_txt),  just = "left") |>
  add_box(txt = pad_box(fu_txt),    just = "left") |>
  add_box(txt = pad_box(an_txt),  just = "left")
plot(g, grViz = TRUE)

gg <- build_grid(g)
```

Save CONSORT diagram
```{r}
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/consort_diagram.pdf", plot = gg, width = 29, height = 50, units = "cm")
ggsave("40_tlf_source/figures/consort_diagram.png", plot = gg, width = 29, height = 50, units = "cm")
```
